method: sensitivity: synthetic full-hourly preventative local fuel dispatch to cover archived N1 import excess, and 13% increased nominal ratings on 3 double-circuit wind collectors; 93 fixed-injection outages each hour; not corrective AC OPF, not a BC Hydro network or demonstrated project feasibility
notes: Preventative dispatch based on archived N1 grid worstcase; no post-fault response, not an AC OPF. Fuel inventories checked per annual total, but no storage/commitment transition restaging.
All 37 buses, 93 parallel circuits, 17 campus allocation and 931 MVAr idealized Q correction are hypothetical.
The AC grid slack is independently checked against external access caps; these have not been contracted.
No PV bus generator Q limits, load-dependent losses feedback, tap controls, harmonics, fault duty or dynamic protections.
